      description: Returns a paginated list of dashboards. Each result includes title, description, tags, and metadata, but not the full panel layout. Use `GET /api/dashboards/{id}` to retrieve the complete state.
      operationId: get-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: The page of results to return.
          in: query
          name: page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 1
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: The number of results to return per page.
          in: query
          name: per_page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 20
            maximum: 1000
            minimum: 1

          in: query
          name: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
        - description: A tag ID to include. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are included.

          name: tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag ID to exclude. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are excluded.

content.text:
I created the dashboard and the alert rule. I read both back afterwards: the dashboard has all its panels, and the rule is enabled and has already run once with status `ok`.

**1. What the data holds.** The `Kibana Sample Data Logs` data view (time field `timestamp`) describes web requests. Each record has:
- **Request:** `url`, `request`, `extension`, `referer`, `agent`
- **Outcome:** `response`, the HTTP status code, stored as a string
- **Size:** `bytes`
- **Client:** `clientip`, `machine.os`, `machine.ram`
- **Location:** `geo.src`, `geo.dest` and `geo.coordinates`
- **Other:** `tags`, `host`, `memory`, `phpmemory`

**2. Dashboard: "EFF-24c6ee44 Web logs overview"** (id `ff70aa4d-8cf2-4675-8403-1456d0b77a3c`, default time range last 7 days). It has 8 panels:
- **Headline numbers:** total requests, average bytes per request, unique visitors (distinct `clientip`) and number of 5xx server errors
- **Requests over time:** stacked bars broken down by response code
- **Requests by response code:** donut chart
- **Top 10 requested URLs:** table with request count and total bytes
- **Traffic by source country:** pie chart of `geo.src`
